I can't give you my hat, but I will give you a hug." The monster looked surprised. After a moment of thinking, he said: "Yes, that's a good idea, I surrender!" Everyone was so happy with the monster's decision. Mary hugged the monster and then put on her hat. They all had a great time together.

Everybody was outside on a sunny day when suddenly Jack noticed something dull in the sky. He looked up and saw what looked like a big grey cloud. He wondered what could be up there, so he asked Mommy. She smiled and said it wasn't a cloud. She went to the backyard and told Jack to follow her. She gave him a telescope and said to point it up at the sky. When Jack did, he was amazed at what he saw! It was a bright, shining star that was twinkling in the sky. Jack was in wonder; he had never seen something so beautiful before. He couldn't believe his eyes when the star suddenly seemed to move. He had discovered a a shooting star! Jack was so excited that he shouted out to everybody inside the house to come and witness the magical sight. Amazed, the whole family watched the shooting star until it became too far away in the night sky. Jack had revealed a beautiful wonder that even Mommy had never seen before.

Sam and Mia love to play at the beach. They like to make sand castles, find shells and splash in the water. One day, they see a big surf board near the shore. It is red and shiny and has a rope on it. "Wow, look at that!" Sam says. "Can we try it?" "I don't know," Mia says. "It looks hard to use. And maybe it belongs to someone." "Let's ask Mom," Sam says. They run to their mom, who is sitting on a towel with a book. "Mom, can we use that surf board? Please?" Mom looks at the surf board and smiles. "Sure, you can use it. But be careful, okay? And stay close to me. The surf board is for the water, not for the sand." "Yay, thank you, Mom!" Sam and Mia say. They grab the rope and drag the surf board to the water. They take turns to sit on it and paddle with their hands. They feel the waves lift them up and down. They laugh and shout with joy. "Look, Mom, I'm surfing!" Sam says. "Me too, me too!" Mia says. They have so much fun that they don't notice a hidden rock under the water. When a big wave comes, the surf board hits the rock and flips over. Sam and Mia fall into the water. They are scared and wet. They cry for help. "Mom, Mom, help us!" they scream. Mom hears them and runs to the water. She grabs the rope and pulls the surf board back. She helps Sam and Mia to get on it. She hugs them and calms them down. "Are you okay, my sweeties?" she asks. "Yes, Mom, we're okay," Sam and Mia say. "But we're sorry. We broke the surf board." Mom looks at the surf board and sees a crack on it. She sighs and says, "Don't worry, we can fix it. Or we can buy a new one. The important thing is that you are safe and happy. But next time, be more careful, okay? And watch out for hidden rocks." "Okay, Mom, we will," Sam and Mia say. They hug Mom and say, "We love you, Mom." "I love you too, my darlings," Mom says. She smiles and says, "Now, let's go and have some ice cream. How does that sound?" "Yummy, yummy, ice cream!" Sam and Mia say. They release the rope and leave the surf board on the shore. They follow Mom to the ice cream truck. They forget about the surf board and the hidden rock. They only think about the ice cream and the fun they had. They are happy.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to a farm with her mom. The farm was big and had many animals. Lily liked the funny ducks that went "quack, quack" and the pigs that went "oink, oink". She also liked the big red barn where the animals slept. Lily saw a big cow and wanted to touch it. She asked her mom, "Can I touch the cow?" Her mom said, "No, Lily, the cow might be scared. We can just look." Lily felt sad because she wanted to be friends with the cow. Lily's mom had an idea. She said, "Let's point at the animals and say their names." They pointed at the ducks and said, "Duck!" They pointed at the pigs and said, "Pig!" When they pointed at the cow and said, "Cow!" the cow looked at them and went "moo!" Lily laughed and felt happy again. The farm was a fun place to be.

Tom was very thoughtful. He always thought about what he could do to help his family. One day he saw a dusty old ashtray on the shelf. He decided to be helpful and polish it. Tom got a cloth and some polish. He carefully rubbed the cloth onto the ashtray. He worked hard and soon the ashtray looked shiny and new. Tom's mum was so pleased when she saw it. She gave Tom a big hug. She said he had been very helpful and thoughtful. Tom was very proud of himself. He smiled and knew he had done a good job.

Once upon a time, there was a factory. It was noisy and smelly, and everyone inside of it was busy. There were machines that sprayed things. One day, a 3 year old girl went to the factory. She wanted to see all of the things that were being sprayed. She wanted to press all of the buttons and play around. But the workers inside the factory told her, "no, it's very dangerous. You can't touch anything!" She was very upset and started to cry. The workers saw that the 3 year old girl was very sad, so they decided to let her help. They told her she could spray a few things, but only if she was careful and listened to everyone. The 3 year old girl sprayed things for a while and it was great fun! But then she made a mistake and sprayed in the wrong direction. Everybody started to yell, "You're so stupid! You ruined everything!" The girl started to cry again and ran out of the factory. She felt like she had been really stupid, and she was very sad. But the next day the workers showed her that the factory was back to normal. They told the girl that even the best of us make mistakes sometimes, and that it's ok. The 3 year old girl smiled and went back to the factory to play with the machines again. She knew that she didn't have to be perfect,

Once upon a time, there was a tall bear. He had a big fluffy tail. The bear loved to go on adventures. One day he went to the forest to find something new and exciting. As he was walking, he heard a sound. Something was squeezing his tail. The bear looked around, but he couldn't see what was squeezing his tail. He jumped and looked around to find the culprit. He saw a small rabbit in the bushes. The bear asked the rabbit why it was squeezing his tail. The rabbit said it was because it was scared. The bear smiled and said it was ok. He asked the rabbit if it wanted to come on an adventure with him. The rabbit hopped up and down with excitement. The bear and the rabbit had lots of fun exploring the forest. They looked in every bush and every tree. The bear would protect the rabbit if he got scared or hugged his tail if it was shaking. They both made sure to have a very fun and safe adventure. When it was time to go home, the bear and the rabbit said goodbye to each other. The bear thought to himself that although using his tail was a bit uncomfortable, he was glad it helped the rabbit feel safe enough to explore.

Sammy and Mummy were in the backyard. Sammy loved being in the backyard because there were lots of yummy strawberries to eat. He had never seen so many strawberries before. Mummy said they should shoot the strawberries with their slingshot. Sammy thought this sounded like a lot of fun so he grabbed his slingshot and Mummy grabbed hers too. They had a race to see who could shoot the most strawberries. Sammy was very excited and he shot at lots of strawberries. He was so proud when he got a big one. Mummy was very proud of her little boy too and gave him a big hug. By the end of the game, Sammy and Mummy had shot so many strawberries that their backyard was full of yummy treats. They took all of the strawberries inside and made a delicious strawberry pie. Yum!

Once upon a time, there was a patient lamp. It waited and waited for someone to mark it. One day, a little girl came into the room. She smiled when she saw the lamp. She was only 3 years old, but she knew right away that she wanted to mark the lamp. The little girl found some markers and chose a yellow one. She carefully marked the lamp with a big sunny smile. The lamp was so happy to finally be marked. The little girl and the lamp were now friends. Every day she would come back to the room and mark the lamp with different kinds of drawings. Every morning the little girl was patient while she marked the lamp into a work of art. The little girl and the lamp were happy together, and they stayed that way for many years to come.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to collect things. She had a big box where she kept all her treasures. One day, she went to the park and saw a pond with many ducks swimming in it. She wanted to collect a duck for her box, but they were too fast for her to catch. Lily sat down on a bench and looked at the ducks. She noticed one duck that looked different from the others. Its feathers were dull and not shiny like the others. She decided to collect that duck and went home to get some bread to feed it. The next day, Lily went back to the pond with her bread. She saw the dull duck again and threw some bread to it. The duck came closer to her and Lily was able to gently pick it up and put it in her box. She was very happy to have a new friend to collect and take care of.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She was very kind and always shared her toys with her friends. One day, Lily's mom told her that they were going to visit her grandma. Lily was happy because she loved her grandma very much. When they arrived at grandma's house, Lily ran inside and shouted, "Surprise!" Grandma was so happy to see her and gave her a big hug and a kiss on the cheek. Lily felt warm inside and giggled with joy. After a while, Lily's mom said it was time to go home. Lily didn't want to leave her grandma, but her mom said they had to go. As they were leaving, Lily saw her grandma's favorite vase on the table. She wanted to give her grandma a present to show how much she loved her. So, she took the vase and ran to her mom's car. But when they got home, Lily's mom saw the vase and asked where she got it from. Lily told her she took it from grandma's house. Her mom was very angry and told her that taking things without asking is not generous or kind. Lily felt sad and wished she could go back and say sorry to her grandma. From that day on, Lily learned that it's always better to ask before taking something, and that being generous means giving from the heart, not taking without permission.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mommy took her to the park to jog. Lily was very excited to go to the park because she loved to play on the swings. As they were jogging, they saw a man teaching some kids how to play soccer. Lily's mommy asked Lily if she wanted to learn how to play soccer too. Lily said yes and ran over to the man. The man was very nice and taught Lily how to kick the ball. Lily was so excited that she kept kicking the ball over and over again. When they finished, Lily thanked the man and said, "I had so much fun! Thank you for teaching me how to play soccer."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the garden with her toys. One day, while she was playing, she saw a beautiful butterfly. She was so eager to catch it that she started running after it. Lily chased the butterfly all around the garden, but she couldn't reach it. She didn't give up and kept trying. Suddenly, she heard her mom calling her for lunch. She was sad that she couldn't catch the butterfly, but she went inside to eat. After lunch, Lily's mom brought out a surprise. It was a butterfly net! Lily was so happy and excited that she hugged her mom and said, "Thank you, mommy! Now I can catch the butterfly!" She ran back outside and used the net to catch the butterfly easily. Lily's heart was filled with joy as she held the butterfly in her hands. She was so happy that she hugged her mom again and said, "I love you, mommy! You always make me happy." From that day on, Lily played with her butterfly net every day and caught many more butterflies.

Once there was a puppy. She lived in a big backyard. The backyard was very big and it had lots of trees, flowers and dirt. The puppy was very silly - she liked to run and play all day. One day, the puppy did something naughty. She dug a big hole in the backyard and made a mess. Her mommy was mad and said she was not allowed to leave the backyard until she said sorry. The puppy was sad and said sorry quickly. Her mommy was so happy that the puppy said sorry and told her that it was ok. She said "I forgive you". The puppy was happy and went to play again. She knew that it was important to forgive and she promised to never do something naughty again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big bookcase in her room that was full of books. Lily loved to read books about princesses and animals. One day, she saw a friendly cat outside her window. The cat meowed and Lily meowed back. They started to talk to each other in a friendly way. The cat told Lily that he liked to climb bookcases too. Lily showed the cat her big bookcase and they both climbed up to the top. They looked at all the books and talked about their favorite stories. Lily was so happy to have a new friendly friend to talk to. From that day on, Lily and the cat would climb the bookcase together and talk about their favorite books.

Tom and Sam were brothers who lived in a small house with their mom and dad. They liked to play outside, but one day it was very cold and wet. The sky was gray and the wind was strong. They could not go out and have fun. They were bored and unhappy. They started to fight over their toys and books. They yelled and pushed each other. Their mom and dad heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. "Why are you fighting, boys?" their mom asked. "You have so many things to play with and share. You should be kind and helpful to each other, not mean and selfish." "But we are tired of playing with the same things," Tom said. "And we want to go outside, but it is too cold and wet." Their dad looked out the window and saw a big pile of wood. He had an idea. He said, "Why don't you help me make a fire in the fireplace? It will provide heat and make the house dry and cozy. Then we can sit by the fire and read stories or play games." Tom and Sam liked the idea. They helped their dad carry the wood and light the fire. They watched the flames dance and crackle. They felt the warmth and the dryness. They stopped fighting and started smiling. They sat by the fire with their mom and dad. They read stories and played games. They thanked their dad for making the fire. They said sorry to each other for being mean and selfish. They learned that fighting is not fun, but helping is. They learned that they can have fun even when it is cold and wet outside, if they have a fire and a family inside.

Once upon a time, there were two humans. One was big and one was little. The little human wanted to show the big human something. She took the big human's hand and said, "Come and see!" Together, they walked to a big tree. The big human said, "What is this?" The little human smiled and pointed at two small birds sitting on a branch. The big human said, "How did they get there?" The little human said, "They flew!" The big human's eyes grew wide. Suddenly, the little bird flew away and the big human began to laugh. The little human laughed too. The little human said, "That was fun! Let's go home now." The big human said, "Yes, let's!" And they walked home, hand in hand.

Once upon a time, there was a family who had just moved into a new house. Everyone was feeling a little bit anxious about the move, but were excited for the new adventure that lay ahead. As soon as the family arrived at their new home, they noticed a bright and colorful sign in the yard. It said "Welcome to the Smiths". Everyone in the family smiled and felt warm inside; this sign made them feel very welcome. They opened the door to their new home and stepped inside. It was cozy and comfortable, just like they had always hoped. Everything was perfect. Now they truly felt at home. Everyone in the family sat down together and enjoyed their new home. From that day on, every time they entered their house they read the welcome sign, and felt happy and content.

Molly was a happy three year old girl. She loved music, dancing and playing with her toys. One day, Molly saw a guitar in the store. She wanted to buy it! Molly asked her mum if she could buy it. 'Yes', said her mum. Molly was so excited! Molly loved to strum the guitar and make music. Soon, she was able to play a few notes. But she had no idea how to make her guitar sound better. That night, Molly heard a noise coming from the next room. She opened the door and saw a man playing the guitar. He was amazing! His fingers flew on the strings and the notes were so beautiful. Molly said loudly, 'Can you teach me?' The man was deaf, so he couldn't hear her. Molly was so disappointed. But that didn't stop Molly from learning the guitar. She kept practising and soon she could play many numbers. In time, she even became a great guitar player!

Once there was a boy named Jack. He loved to go to the mill. He would push open the door and feel the warm air. Inside it was quiet and still. He liked to look around, watching the mill work. Then he would push the buttons on the big machine and wait for the mill to grind the grain. One day, he decided to take a nap on the warm floor. He closed his eyes and felt the warmth of the sun shining on him. Suddenly, he heard a sound! He opened his eyes and saw a little mouse pushing through the grain bags. Jack was so surprised he couldn't help but laugh. He got up and chased the mouse, pushing it out of the mill. The next day, Jack came back to the mill. He felt excited to push the buttons and watch the grain get milled. He made sure to stay away from the mouse, just in case it came back!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved animals and wanted to have a pet. One day, Timmy's parents took him to a pet store. Timmy saw a cute little bunny in a cage and asked his parents if he could have it as a pet. His parents said they would have to test if Timmy was ready to take care of a pet. They asked Timmy questions like, "Will you feed the bunny every day?" and "Will you clean its cage?" Timmy answered yes to all the questions. His parents were happy and bought the bunny for Timmy. Timmy was so excited to take the bunny home. When they got home, Timmy gave the bunny some yummy carrots and put it in its new cage. The bunny was happy and Timmy was happy too.

Once upon a time on a bright sunny day there was a little bird named Sammy. Sammy was a special bird because he had the power to soar. He loved to soar high above the clouds, feeling the wind lift all the weight from his wings. One day, Sammy flew to a meadow full of beautiful flowers. He looked around, feeling free, but there was one problem: the flowers all seemed so sad. Sammy knew he had to do something to make them happy. Suddenly, Sammy had an idea. He flew down to the closest flower, and said, "Why are you so sad?". The flower replied, "It's not fair! All the other birds get to fly up in the sky and I don't". "I think I can help" said Sammy. He flapped his wings and circled up, up, up in to the sky. "Come on, follow me!" he called out to the other flowers. The flowers flew up behind Sammy, feeling the weight on their petals fall away. It felt amazing, so they kept soaring higher and higher. Sammy smiled, feeling good inside. All the flowers felt happy and free, just like him. Soaring together was the fairest thing of all.

Once there was a deaf girl who liked to have fun. On every holiday, she liked to fold just about everything she saw. She folded all of her blankets, her pillows, her stuffed animals and even her clothes! One day, she went on a vacation with her family. On the airplane, she was bored so she started to fold the napkins and tissues they gave her. When she saw the people around her, she even tried folding their newspapers and books. When they arrived at their destination, the little girl thought it was the perfect time to have some more fun. She found lots of things to fold, like her mom's towel, her dad's hat and even her brother's shoes! Then, she kept making fun folding shapes, like animals, birds and drums. Finally, it was time to go back home. On the flight, the girl was not as bored as before. So, instead of folding, she just watched all the people around her. She was so amazed how everybody was talking, it almost felt like a special holiday for the deaf girl!

Jim was sad. He wanted to play with his friends but they had all gone. Jim thought of a plan - he would make a promise. He would put the promise in a box and save it for his friends when they returned. He all made the promise. He put it in the box and locked it. He hoped his friends would remember it when they came back. But soon after that bad things started happening. The box got bigger and bigger, and soon it was bigger than Jim. He couldn't open it because it had grown so big. One day the box began to shake and rumble. Jim knew it was too late, he had made the wrong promise. It was a sad ending.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and read her books. One day, Lily's mommy told her that there was a special chair available for her in the living room. Lily didn't know what her mommy meant by "available", but she was excited to see the new chair. When she got to the living room, she saw the chair and knew it was just for her. Lily sat in the chair and felt very happy. She knew she would spend a lot of time in her new chair, reading her books and playing with her toys. From that day on, Lily's chair was her favorite place to be.

Once upon a time there was a little mouse. He was very healthy and strong. He loved to play all day and eat yummy food. At night, the mouse would take a nap. He would find a cozy place and lay down. As soon as his head touched the ground he would go fast to sleep. When the mouse woke up he would hop around, looking for food. He would eat little seeds and crunchy bugs. During the day he would also play with his friends. But no matter how much fun he had, when it was time for bed he would always go back to sleep. He was a happy and healthy mouse. And he liked to sleep a lot.

Once upon a time, there was a big red ball named Basketball. Basketball was always happy and loved to play with his friends. One day, Basketball met a new friend named Fake. Fake was not a real ball, but a toy that looked like a ball. Basketball and Fake became good friends and played together every day. One sunny day, Basketball and Fake had a quarrel. They were playing a game, and Basketball thought Fake was not playing fair. Basketball was sad and angry. Fake was also sad and angry. They stopped playing and went to different places in the park. After some time, Basketball and Fake thought about their quarrel. They both felt bad and missed playing together. Basketball decided to find Fake and say sorry. When Basketball found Fake, they both said sorry to each other. They promised to play fair and be good friends again. From that day on, Basketball and Fake played happily together. They learned that even good friends can have quarrels, but saying sorry and forgiving each other is important. And they all lived happily ever after.

The sun was shining brightly, the sky was blue, and it was a perfect day for playing. Mark skipped outside wearing his new belt, which glowed brightly in the sunshine. He felt so excited and enthusiastic about the day ahead. He ran to the park and saw his friends Emily and Julie, who were also wearing glowing belts. The three of them jumped and laughed and spun around until they were dizzy. They smiled and hugged each other with glee. After playing some more, the friends decided it was time for a snack. They went to get ice cream from the shop and Mark's belt glowed even brighter. They sat in the park, enjoying their candy and the warm sun. Mark was very happy. He loved his new belt and was so enthusiastic to spend the day playing in the park with his newfound friends. He knew these good times would stay with him forever.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Ryan. He was three years old and he loved to wear nice clothes. He had a special shirt that was very expensive. One day, he wanted to show the shirt off to his friends. He put on the shirt and ran outside. He shouted, "Look at my shirt! It's so nice!" All of his friends stopped and looked. They were so impressed by how expensive it was. Ryan was very proud of his shirt. He continued to run around and show it off. Suddenly, a gust of wind came and the shirt flew off of his body. He shouted, "My shirt!" and tried to catch it. But it was too late, the shirt landed in a nearby pond. Ryan was sad, he knew he wouldn't be able to wear it again. But his friends quickly cheered him up. They gave him hugs and told him that something else just as nice would come along soon.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was a loyal friend to his owner, Timmy. Timmy loved to draw on his blackboard and Max liked to watch him. One day, Timmy wanted to teach Max a new trick. He told Max to lay down on the ground. Max didn't understand at first, but Timmy showed him what to do. Max laid down and Timmy gave him a treat. From then on, Max knew how to lay down whenever Timmy said the word. Timmy was so proud of his loyal dog!

Once upon a time, there was a small girl named Lily. She had a small notebook which she loved to draw in. One day, Lily went to the park to play with her friends. While playing, she lost her small notebook. She looked everywhere but couldn't find it. Lily started to cry and her friends tried to help her. One of them said, "Let's call your mommy and ask her to help us find it." So, they called Lily's mommy and told her what happened. Lily's mommy came to the park and helped them search for the small notebook. Finally, they found it under a tree. Lily was so happy and hugged her mommy tightly. She said, "Thank you mommy for finding my small notebook." From that day on, Lily made sure to keep her small notebook safe and never lost it again.

Once upon a time, there was a blue bird named Bob. Bob lived in a tree with a hole. He liked to fly and find food. One day, he found a big red apple. He wanted to feed his family with it. Bob tried to put the apple in the hole, but it was too big. He tried and tried, but the apple would not go in. Bob's friend, a squirrel named Sam, saw him and asked, "What's wrong, Bob?" "I can't get this apple in the hole to feed my family," said Bob. Sam thought for a moment and said, "Let's break the apple into smaller pieces." Together, they broke the apple into smaller pieces. Bob was able to put the pieces in the hole and feed his family. They were all very happy and thanked Sam for his help. From that day on, Bob and Sam became best friends and always helped each other.

Sara and Tom like to play in the park. They like to climb the trees and swing on the branches. One day, they find a big branch on the ground. It is brown and hard and has many leaves. "Look, Tom, this is a magic branch!" Sara says. "We can wear it like a crown and be the king and queen of the park!" Tom likes the idea. He helps Sara put the branch on her head. It is heavy and prickly, but Sara does not mind. She feels like a queen. She gives Tom a leaf to wear on his head. He feels like a king. They walk around the park, holding hands and smiling. They see a man sitting on a bench. He is old and has white hair and a long beard. He looks at Sara and Tom and smiles. "Hello, little ones," he says. "What are you wearing on your heads?" Sara and Tom tell him about the magic branch. They say it makes them the king and queen of the park. The man nods and laughs. He says, "You have a good imagination. Do you know where this branch came from?" Sara and Tom shake their heads. They do not know. The man says, "This branch is very old. It is ancient. It came from a tree that was here before the park was made. It was a big and beautiful tree. It gave shade and fruits and flowers to many people and animals. But one day, a storm came and broke the tree. The branch fell to the ground and stayed there for a long time. It is a part of the history of this place." Sara and Tom listen to the man. They feel amazed and curious. They ask him more questions about the tree and the park and the storm. The man tells them many stories. He is happy to share his knowledge and memories. Sara and Tom are happy to learn and listen. They thank the man for his stories. They say goodbye and go back to their game. They still wear the branch and the leaf on their heads. They feel proud and special. They have a magic branch that connects them to the past and the present. They have a new friend who teaches them about the world. They have each other to play and have fun. They are the king and queen of the park.

Lily and Tom are at the park with their mom. They like to play on the swings and the slide. They also like to look at the birds and the flowers. Sometimes they gaze at the sky and see the clouds and the sun. Mom says it is time to go home. She tells Lily and Tom to come to the bench. She has a surprise for them. Lily and Tom run to the bench. They are curious and excited. Mom opens her bag and takes out two ice creams. One is chocolate and one is vanilla. She gives one to Lily and one to Tom. She says they can choose which one they want. Lily and Tom are happy. They thank mom and lick their ice creams. Mom says they have to eat quickly because the ice creams will melt. She also says they have to be careful not to drop them or make a mess. Lily and Tom nod and eat their ice creams. They enjoy the cold and sweet taste. A big truck passes by the park. It is very noisy. It makes a loud honk and a rumble. Lily and Tom are scared. They drop their ice creams on the ground. They cry and hug mom. Mom says it is okay. She says the truck is just doing its job. She says she will buy them new ice creams later. She says they have to follow her order and go home now. Lily and Tom wipe their tears and hold mom's hand. They walk home with mom. They hope the truck will not come back.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run and play outside. One day, Lily's mommy said, "Let's go for a jog!" Lily was so excited to run with her mommy. As they were jogging, Lily noticed her mommy's body was very flexible. She asked, "Mommy, how do you get so flexible?" Her mommy replied, "I stretch every day to get flexible." Lily wanted to be flexible like her mommy, so she started stretching too. Every day, she would stretch her arms and legs. Soon enough, Lily became very flexible just like her mommy. From that day on, they would go on jogs together and show off their flexibility.

One day, a thoughtful girl named Ann found some clay. She was very happy. Ann had a great idea. She wanted to make a gift for her mom. "I will make something nice," she said. Ann took the clay and made a big ball. Then, she made a small ball. She put the small ball on the big ball. "This will be a snowman," she said with a big smile. Ann was very proud. Ann showed her mom the clay snowman. Her mom was so happy. She gave Ann a big hug. "You are so thoughtful," her mom said. Ann felt good. She knew her clay snowman was special.

Tom and Sue like to jog. They jog every day. They jog by the harbor. The harbor has many boats. Some boats are big and some boats are small. Tom and Sue like to look at the boats. One day, they see a fat cat on a boat. The cat is black and white. The cat is sleeping on a chair. Tom and Sue think the cat is cute. They want to pet the cat. "Hello, cat!" Tom says. "Can we pet you?" The cat opens one eye. The cat looks at Tom and Sue. The cat does not like strangers. The cat hisses at Tom and Sue. "Go away!" the cat says. "This is my boat. You are not welcome here." Tom and Sue are scared. They do not want to make the cat angry. They say sorry to the cat. They jog away from the boat. They jog to another boat. The other boat has a dog. The dog is friendly. The dog wags its tail. Tom and Sue pet the dog. The dog licks their faces. "Hello, dog!" Sue says. "You are very nice. Can we be your friends?" The dog barks happily. The dog likes Tom and Sue. The dog invites them to play. Tom and Sue play with the dog. They have fun. They forget about the fat cat. They are glad they jog by the harbor.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jill. Jack and Jill went up the hill to play a game. The game was silly. Jack and Jill took turns pushing a big button. Every time they pushed the button they would separate. Jack shouted: "Let's try again!" So they took turns pushing the button again. This time the button spun them around and around until they were dizzy. Jill giggled and said: "That was so silly!" Jack laughed and said: "Let's try the button one more time!" So they pressed the button again and this time it sent them soaring high into the sky! Jack and Jill flew around, but eventually the button sent them back down to the ground. They were safe and sound, but something was different this time. Jack and Jill were no longer together. The button had separated them! But it was all worth it in the end, because a silly game can bring people together in the most unexpected of ways.

Tom and Lily were playing in the garden. They saw a big red flower. It was very pretty. "Can I touch it?" Lily asked Tom. Tom shook his head. "No, Lily. That is a burn flower. It can hurt you." Lily was curious. She wanted to know more. "Why does it burn?" she asked. Tom shrugged. "I don't know. Mama said it is a burn flower. She said we should stay away from it." Lily nodded. She did not want to get hurt. But she still liked the flower. It was very bright and shiny. "Can we look at it?" she asked. Tom smiled. He liked Lily. She was his best friend. She was very adorable. "Okay, we can look at it. But we have to be careful. We have to stay far away from it." Tom and Lily walked slowly to the flower. They did not touch it. They just looked at it. They saw a little bee. It was flying around the flower. It was very busy. "Look, Tom. A bee!" Lily said. Tom looked. He saw the bee. He was not afraid of bees. He liked bees. They made honey. "Hello, bee!" Tom said. The bee heard Tom. It flew to him. It landed on his nose. Tom giggled. He felt the bee tickle his nose. Lily laughed. She thought Tom was very funny. The bee was friendly. It did not sting Tom. It just said hello. Then it flew away. It went back to the flower. Tom and Lily waved to the bee. They said goodbye. They were happy. They had a new friend. They decided to name the flower Bee Flower. They thought it was a better name than Burn Flower. They went back to their toys. They played some more. They had a lot of fun in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color pictures of flowers and animals. One day, she asked her mommy if she could print out a picture of a unicorn to color. Her mommy said yes and printed it for her. But then, something serious happened. A big, scary tornado came and started blowing everything around. Lily and her mommy had to go hide in the basement until it was safe again. When they came back upstairs, they saw that the tornado had knocked down trees and houses. Lily was sad, but her mommy told her that they were lucky to be safe. They hugged each other and looked at the unicorn picture that was still on the table. Lily smiled and said, "I'm glad you printed it for me, mommy."

Once upon a time, there were two little kids. Their names were Jane and Joe. Jane was brave and always wanting to do something new. One day, she dared Joe to jump off of the swing. Joe was scared but he said yes. He was scared at first, but it was so much fun! Jane had a surprise for him after. She took him to the store. Joe saw a little car! He was so excited and he wanted it so badly. Jane told him that she dared him to jump off the swing so she could get him the little car. Joe was so happy and couldn't believe his surprise. He thanked Jane for being so brave and giving him the surprise. They had lots of fun playing together with the little car.

Molly and Max were best friends. Today was a special day as they were both going to visit a stable. The two children could not believe their eyes as they got their first glimpse of the stable. It was made of straw, and it looked soft and inviting. "Let's go inside," said Molly. Max felt excited but also a little scared. He asked, "What will be in there?" Molly smiled and said "We will get to meet lots of horses and maybe even lay on some of them." Max was so excited. He couldn't wait. They both went inside and lay on the horses. The horses were soft and nice, and it felt really special to be so close to them. Molly smiled at Max. "That was fun wasn't it?" she said. Max nodded eagerly. He was so happy he had come to the stable. He knew this was a special moment he would never forget.

Tom and Lily were twins who loved to play at the beach. They liked to build sand castles, find shells and splash in the water. One day, they saw a big boat on the sea. It was white and shiny and had a flag on it. "Look, Lily, a boat!" Tom said. "I want to go on it and move on the sea." "Me too, Tom," Lily said. "But we can't. It is too far and we are too small." They watched the boat move on the sea until it was out of sight. They felt sad and wished they could go on it. Then, they heard a voice behind them. It was their dad. He had a surprise for them. He had rented a small boat for them to ride on the sea. He had life jackets, snacks and toys for them. "Hi, kids, are you ready for some fun?" he said. "We are going on a boat ride on the sea. You are very lucky today." Tom and Lily were so happy. They hugged their dad and ran to the boat. They put on their life jackets and got on the boat. Their dad started the engine and the boat began to move on the sea. Tom and Lily felt the wind in their hair and the sun on their faces. They saw fish, birds and waves. They ate snacks and played with toys. They had a lot of fun on the boat. They thanked their dad for the surprise and told him they loved him. They felt very lucky to have such a nice dad and such a fun day on the sea.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to look at the moon at night. One day, she asked her mother, "Can I receive the moon as a gift?" Her mother smiled and said, "No, sweetie. The moon is too far away." Lily was sad, but she didn't give up. She went outside every night to look at the moon. One night, she saw a shooting star and made a wish to receive the moon. The next day, she woke up deaf. She couldn't hear anything anymore. Lily went to the doctor, but they couldn't fix her ears. She was very sad and cried a lot. Her mother hugged her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. You can't receive the moon, but you still have me." Lily hugged her mother back and smiled a little.

One day, a boy named Tim wanted to sail on a boat. He asked his mom, "Can I sail on the boat today?" His mom said, "Yes, but be careful." Tim went to the river and saw a boat. He got in and started to sail. The wind was strong, and the boat went fast. Tim was having a lot of fun. As he sailed, he saw a big fish jump out of the water. The fish said, "You are sailing too fast, and that is stupid!" Tim laughed and said, "I will slow down." He sailed slower and saw more fish and birds. When Tim got home, he told his mom about his adventure. His mom said, "Let's make a video of you telling your story." They made a video, and Tim was happy. He learned that it's important to be safe and not do stupid things while sailing.

A little girl named Sue was having a tea party with some of her stuffed animals. She had planned it days in advance, and was very excited. She had made a delicious pot of tea for her guests and all the decorations were in place. Everything was ready for the perfect tea party. But then, something unexpected happened. Sue's best friend came over with a basket full of cookies and wanted to join the tea party. Suddenly, Sue was very dizzy. She had planned the tea party for only her stuffed animals, not her friend! She was feeling very upset. Sue thought very hard and decided to make a plan. She invited her friend to have some tea and cookies, but then asked her to sneak away so that the tea party could continue as planned. Her friend agreed, and Sue was happy again. The tea party was a success and everyone was happy. Sue was proud of her plan, which had allowed her to have her tea party just the way she wanted it.

Once upon a time, there was a little sailor who loved to explore the sea. He had a big boat with a flag that flapped in the wind. One day, the sailor felt very hungry and decided to stop at an island to find some food. As he walked on the island, he saw a big coconut tree with lots of coconuts. But the sailor was too small to climb the tree. He thought to himself, "I dare not climb the tree. What if I fall?" Just then, a friendly monkey appeared and offered to help the sailor. The monkey climbed up the tree and threw down some coconuts for the sailor to eat. The sailor was very happy and thanked the monkey. From that day on, the sailor and the monkey became good friends and went on many adventures together. And whenever the sailor felt hungry, he knew he could count on his friend to help him find some food.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat yummy food. One day, her mommy called her to come and eat dinner. "Are you ready to eat, Lily?" her mommy asked. Lily nodded and said, "Yes, mommy, I am ready!" On the plate, Lily saw some broccoli. She remembered that her mommy always said broccoli was good for her. Lily took a bite and smiled. "I like broccoli, mommy!" she said happily. Mommy was proud of Lily for trying the broccoli. They both finished their dinner and then played with Lily's toys. They had a fun time and Lily remembered to always be ready to try new things.

Once upon a time there were two friends, one named Sam and the other named Pam. They both wanted to play catch and pitch a ball together. So Sam had an idea. He hoped that if he pitched the ball then Pam could catch it and then he shouted, "Let's play!" Pam was very happy when Sam pitched the ball and was excited to try to catch it. But when Pam tried to catch the ball, it was too silly. She laughed and tried again and again, but it kept looking silly. Watching Pam, Sam could tell she was struggling. He thought and thought of a way to help and then he had an idea. He said, "Hey, why don't you stand a little closer so it's easier to catch the ball?" Pam was excited with Sam's idea and tried it. She began to catch the ball with ease and Sam cheered for her. They played catch for a long time and had lots of fun, and they even hugged each other when they both went home. The end.

Once there was a family of bear bears. Everyone was very happy and they had lots of fun together. One day, the family was getting ready to go to a party. They wanted to make sure they looked nice and had the best welcome. So they all worked together to prepare, and it was a tough job. Finally, the day arrived and the family set out for the party. When they got there, everything was not as they had expected. There was a sign at the door that said "No bear bears allowed." The family members were very sad and disappointed. They were so surprised that they all just sat there, without saying a word. Suddenly, the father bear bear spoke. He said, "This is a tough lesson, but the best thing to do is to move on. We should remember that no matter how hard we prepare, not everyone will welcome us." And with this, the family sadly walked away. They had learned a valuable lesson that day: no matter how much we try to be welcomed, some people will never accept us.

Once upon a time, there was a brave explorer named Jane. She had been travelling for many days and was exhausted. She decided to take a break in a very small oasis. When she arrived, it seemed so beautiful. The trees and flowers looked so pretty. Jane was so captivated, she decided to stay and rest for a while. Suddenly, the air turned chilly. Jane felt a little scared, but she decided to keep exploring. She started walking in one direction, and soon came across a terrible sight - a dense fog covering the whole oasis. Jane was so scared that she screamed, "What should I do?" Suddenly, Jane heard a hissing noise from behind her. She turned around and saw a big, black snake slithering towards her. Even though she was petrified, Jane managed to run away as fast as possible and climbed a big tree for safety. But the fog was too thick and the snake kept chasing her. It was a terrible sight. Jane screamed for help, but no one came to save her. Eventually, the snake bit her off the tree and devoured her. The brave explorer was gone forever, and so was the oasis, covered in a terrible fog.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved books and her mommy took her to the library every week. The library was a big room with lots of shelves filled with books. One day, Lily decided to organize her own little library in her room. She put all her books in a pile and started to sort them by size and color. She was very organized! Lily's mommy was very proud of her for organizing her books. She even helped Lily make little labels for each section of her library. Now Lily could easily find the book she wanted to read. And she was very happy!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to draw and make things. One day, she decided to design a special card for her mom's birthday. She used lots of colors and made a pretty message that said "I love you, Mommy!" Lily showed the card to her dad and he thought it was crazy good! He helped her make a special envelope to put the card in. On her mom's birthday, Lily gave her the card and her mom was so happy! She said it was the best present ever. Lily felt proud of herself for designing such a special card for her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a big, strong robot made of steel. His name was Robby. He lived in a big city where he helped people with his intelligent brain. One day, Robby saw a little girl crying. He went over to her and asked, "Why are you sad?" The little girl said, "I lost my teddy bear. I can't find him anywhere." Robby smiled and said, "Don't worry. I will help you find your teddy bear." So, Robby used his intelligent brain to search for the teddy bear. He looked everywhere until he finally found it. The little girl was so happy that she smiled and gave Robby a big hug. From that day on, the little girl and Robby became good friends. They would play together and have lots of fun. And every time the little girl saw Robby, she would smile and say, "Thank you for helping me find my teddy bear."

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and share them. But sometimes they fight over who gets what. One day, they find a big sock in their room. It is red and soft and has a hole at the end. "Look, a sock!" Anna says. "I want it!" "No, I want it!" Ben says. "It is mine!" They both grab the sock and pull it hard. The sock stretches and tears. They hear a loud rip. They stop and look at the sock. It is broken in two pieces. "Oh no!" Anna says. "We broke the sock!" "It is your fault!" Ben says. "You pulled too hard!" "It is your fault!" Anna says. "You did not let go!" They start to cry. They hear their mom coming up the stairs. They are afraid she will be angry. "Mom, we are sorry!" they say. "We broke the sock!" Mom comes in and sees the sock. She is not angry. She smiles and hugs them. "It is okay, my loves," she says. "It was an old sock. I was going to throw it away. But I have a surprise for you. Look what I found in the sock!" She shows them two shiny coins. One for Anna and one for Ben. "Wow!" they say. "Coins!" "These are for you," Mom says. "You can buy something nice with them. But remember, you have to share and be fair. Okay?" "Okay, Mom," they say. "Thank you!" They hug Mom and each other. They are happy. They learned a lesson. They will try to be fair and not fight over things. They will share and play nicely. They will love their sock and their coins. And their mom. The end.

John was at school. He had been in the same class since he was three years old. His teacher was Mrs. Wilson. Today, she was leaning against the wall in the classroom. She was a little fat. John walked up to Mrs. Wilson. He looked up at her with a smile. "Mrs. Wilson," John said, "why are you standing near the wall?" Mrs. Wilson laughed. She leaned down and looked John in the eyes. "Well, John, it's because I'm a bit fat! Standing near the wall helps me to stay balanced." John thought about that for a moment. Then he smiled and said, "Yeah, I think I understand now. Thank you Mrs. Wilson!" Mrs. Wilson smiled back. "You're welcome, John. It's nice to see you learning." John smiled again and went back to his work.

Tim and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their toys. They have many toys, but their favorite is a big cage with two birds inside. The birds are blue and yellow. They can sing and fly. One day, Tim and Sam have a fight. They both want to play with the cage. Tim says, "It is my turn. I want to make the birds sing." Sam says, "No, it is my turn. I want to make the birds fly." They pull the cage from each other. They are very competitive. The birds are scared. They do not like the noise and the shaking. They flap their wings and peck the bars. They want to get out of the cage. They tell Tim and Sam, "Stop! Stop! You are hurting us. Let us go. We are not toys. We are alive." Tim and Sam hear the birds. They are surprised. They did not know the birds can talk. They feel sorry for the birds. They stop fighting. They say, "We are sorry, birds. We did not mean to hurt you. We will let you go. You can fly and sing in the sky." They open the cage and set the birds free. The birds are happy. They thank Tim and Sam. They say, "You are good boys. You learned your lesson. Be kind to each other and to animals. Goodbye." They fly away and sing a beautiful song. Tim and Sam hug each other. They say, "We are sorry, brother. We will not fight again. We will share our toys and play nicely." They smile and go to play with their other toys. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Bella. Bella was very attractive and she loved to have massages. Every week, Bella would go to her special massage place and have a massage. She would have it for so long that she felt amazing afterwards. The massage was very special. It had special oils that made Bella's skin feel very soft and smooth. Bella felt so special and relaxed after the massage. One day, Bella had gone to have her massage only to discover that the massage master had left for vacation. Bella was disappointed and did not know who would give her the massage now. She waited and waited until finally, another massage master arrived. This massage master was even more attractive than the one before! The massage was even more special and felt even better. At the end, Bella was so relaxed and happy that she fell asleep. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a clever little girl named Lily. She loved to do things with her hands, like coloring and building with blocks. One day, she spilled juice on the floor and her mommy gave her a rag to clean it up. Lily wiped and wiped until the floor was clean. Her mommy was so proud of how clever she was to know what to do with the rag. From then on, Lily always kept a rag close by, just in case she needed to clean up a mess.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat jelly sandwiches with her mommy. One day, her mommy brought home a new jar of jelly. Lily was so excited to try it! She opened the jar and twisted the lid off. She scooped some jelly onto her sandwich and took a big bite. It was the best jelly she had ever tasted! She asked her mommy if they could have jelly sandwiches every day with the new jelly. Her mommy smiled and said they could have them as often as they wanted. From that day on, Lily and her mommy enjoyed their new jelly sandwiches together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a favorite rag doll that she carried everywhere. The doll was very fragile, so she had to be careful not to drop her. One day, Lily and her mom went to the park. While they were playing, Lily saw a little boy crying. She went to him and asked, "Why are you sad?" The boy answered, "I lost my toy." Lily wanted to help the boy find his toy, so she asked him, "What does it look like?" The boy described his toy and Lily looked around. Suddenly, she saw something on the ground. It was the boy's toy! Lily picked it up and gave it to the boy. He was so happy and said, "Thank you!" Lily smiled and hugged her rag doll tightly. She was happy too because she helped someone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to her meetings with her friends at the park. One day, while they were playing, they heard a scary noise. "What was that?" asked Lily. "I don't know," said her friend, Timmy. "Let's listen carefully." They stopped playing and listened. Suddenly, they heard the noise again. "It's coming from the bushes!" cried Lily. They were scared, but they decided to go closer to see what it was. As they got closer, they saw a cute little bunny hopping out of the bushes. "Oh, it's just a bunny!" said Timmy. Lily and Timmy laughed and played with the bunny. They forgot about their scary moment and continued having fun. From that day on, they always listened carefully for any scary noises, but they knew that sometimes it was just a cute little bunny.

Lily and Ben are best friends. They like to play with their toys and make funny noises. One day, they find a big box in the garage. They wonder what is inside. "Let's open it!" Lily says. "OK!" Ben says. They pull and tug at the box until it opens. Inside, they see a lot of shiny things. They are snaps. Snaps are small metal things that make a loud sound when you press them together. "Wow!" Lily says. "Look at all the snaps!" "Can we play with them?" Ben asks. "Sure!" Lily says. "But be careful. They are loud and hard." They take some snaps and start to press them together. They make a lot of noise and laugh. They pretend they are making music or fireworks. They have a lot of fun. Then, they see something else in the box. It is a small, fluffy animal. It has long ears, a pink nose and a cute tail. It is a bunny. It is adorable. "Look!" Ben says. "A bunny!" "Aww!" Lily says. "It is so cute!" They pick up the bunny and cuddle it. It is soft and warm. It makes a quiet sound. It is happy. "What is its name?" Lily asks. "I don't know," Ben says. "Do you have a name for it?" Lily thinks for a moment. She looks at the bunny and smiles. "How about Snap?" she says. "Because we found it with the snaps." "I like it!" Ben says. "Snap is a good name for a bunny." They hug Snap and put it back in the box. They decide to keep it as their pet. They also keep some snaps to play with. They are very happy. They have a new friend and a new toy. They love Snap and Snap loves them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a big swing and asked her mommy if she could have a turn. Her mommy said yes and helped her get on the swing. Lily felt happy and excited as she swung back and forth. After playing on the swing, Lily and her mommy went back home. They had a gentle tea party with some cookies. Lily loved the tea and said it tasted yummy. She felt warm and cozy inside as she sipped her tea. Lily had a fun day playing outside and having tea with her mommy. She went to bed that night with a big smile on her face, dreaming of swinging on the big swing again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to play. She loved to run and jump, and laugh and sing. She was so playful! One day the little girl found a cage outside her house. Inside the cage was a tiny puppy who was sad and lonely. The little girl wanted to help the puppy, so she asked her parents if she could keep it. Her parents said yes and she was so excited. Every day the little girl and her puppy played together. She taught the puppy to be brave and to do tricks like sit and stay. They had lots of fun and the puppy soon became very happy. One day they had a play competition. The little girl and her puppy ran and jumped and had the most fun. In the end, the little girl and her puppy won the game. They were so proud, and now they were the happiest puppy and owner around!

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweetie. Tweetie had a smooth, yellow body and loved to whistle all day long. One day, Tweetie was flying in the forest when she saw a big, juicy worm. Tweetie's tummy rumbled and she felt an urge to eat the worm. But then, Tweetie heard a voice. "Don't eat that worm, Tweetie! It's not safe!" It was her friend, Wise Owl. "Why not?" asked Tweetie. "It's poisoned," replied Wise Owl. "Oh no!" cried Tweetie. "Thank you for warning me, Wise Owl." From that day on, Tweetie listened to Wise Owl's advice and never ate anything without checking with him first. But one day, Tweetie was flying and whistling when she saw a pretty red berry. She forgot to ask Wise Owl and ate it anyway. Sadly, it was poisonous and Tweetie fell from the sky. The moral of the story is to always listen to wise advice and never eat anything without checking if it's safe.

Once upon a time, there was a kind and compassionate girl. She loved to ride her bike around her neighbourhood, feeling the breeze on her face. One day, as she was riding, she spotted a coin in the road. She got off her bike and picked it up. The girl was so excited because she knew that this coin could help her buy something special. She decided to use the coin to visit her local animal shelter. As soon as she arrived, the girl was greeted by all the tails wagging and the purring cats. She looked around and spotted a scruffy little pup. He looked so sad and lonely. She immediately knew that she had to adopt him. The girl got back on her bike and rode home with the pup, feeling excited to be a new pet-parent. From then on, she kept the coin as a reminder of her compassionate act, a sign of how she chose to spend her money.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to play at the park. He saw a big structure to climb on. It had slides and swings. Tim was excited to play on it. He looked around and saw that it was available. No other kids were playing on it. As Tim started to climb, he saw a small bird on the structure. The bird said, "Please don't climb on my home." Tim wanted to play, but he tried to resist. He didn't want to hurt the bird's home. Tim said, "Okay, I won't climb on your home." The bird was happy and thanked Tim. Then, the bird flew away to find a new place to live. Now, Tim could play on the structure without worrying about the bird. He had lots of fun at the park that day.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big tree with red apples on it. They wanted to pick some apples to eat, but the tree was too high for them. "Look, there is a ladder!" Ben said. He pointed to a wooden ladder that was hidden behind some bushes. "We can use it to climb the tree and get the apples." Lily was not sure. She thought the ladder looked old and shaky. She was afraid it might break or fall. "I don't think we should use that ladder," she said. "It is not safe. Maybe the apples belong to someone else." Ben did not listen to Lily. He ran to the ladder and started to climb. He reached the first branch and grabbed an apple. He smiled and said, "This apple is so juicy and sweet. Come on, Lily, don't be scared. There are more apples for us." Lily shook her head. She stayed on the ground and watched Ben. She hoped he would be careful. But then, she heard a loud crack. The ladder broke and Ben fell down. He hit the ground hard and cried out in pain. Lily ran to Ben and saw that he had hurt his arm and leg. She felt sorry for him and tried to help him. She said, "Ben, are you okay? I'm sorry you fell. We should go and find a grown-up to help you." Ben nodded and said, "Lily, you were right. I was wrong. I should have listened to you. The ladder was not safe. The apples were not worth it. I'm sorry I was greedy and foolish." Lily and Ben learned a lesson that day. They learned that they should be careful and respectful. They learned that they should listen to their friends and not take what is not theirs. They learned that sometimes, the best things are not hidden, but right in front of them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy was playing in her room when she saw a toy toilet. She loved the toy toilet and wanted to play with it all day. She knew she had to rub the toy toilet to make it work. So, she rubbed it and waited to see what would happen. Amy's mom was in the kitchen and she was making a yucky, bitter drink. She knew Amy didn't like bitter things, but she wanted her to try it. She called Amy to come and taste the drink. Amy left the toy toilet in her room and went to the kitchen. Amy tasted the bitter drink and made a funny face. She didn't like it at all. She ran back to her room, feeling sad. But when she got there, she saw the toy toilet had changed. It was now a magical toy toilet! It could make any drink taste good. Amy was so happy, she rubbed the toy toilet again and wished for the bitter drink to taste good. She ran back to the kitchen, and when she tasted the drink again, it was yummy! Amy and her mom laughed and enjoyed the drink together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went to school every day with her friends. Lily loved school because she learned new things every day. Her teacher was very nice and gifted her a sticker every time she did well on a task. One day, after school, Lily went to the store with her mom. She saw so many toys and candies there. She wanted to buy them all but her mom said she could only choose one. She picked a small toy and was very happy. When Lily went back to school the next day, she showed her teacher the toy she got from the store. Her teacher was happy for her and gave her another sticker for being so kind to share her gift with the class. From that day on, Lily knew that it was better to share her gifts with others.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Sue. They liked to play together. One day Jack and Sue decided to play in the field. As they walked they saw a big pile of hay. They wanted to jump on it! Jack asked, "What do you think is inside?" Sue said, "I don't know, let's flip it over and find out!" So they got down and started pushing the pile of hay. It was hard and they struggled together, but they managed to push it over. Inside they found a baby plant. Its little leaves were green and it was trying to grow. Jack said, "Let's help it grow!" So they got some water and poured it on the soil around the plant. Then they took some of the hard hay and put it around the plant. They watched it for a few days and soon the baby plant started growing bigger and stronger. Jack and Sue were very happy and proud that they helped the little plant grow.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play in the park. One day, he saw a new game with many players. He wanted to join them and play too. The game was called "Freeze Tag". The player who was "it" had to run and tag others. When a player was tagged, they had to freeze like a statue. Tim was very excited to play. He knew he was fast and could tag many players. Tim played and played. He tagged many players and they all froze. But then, Tim saw a little girl who was sad. She had been frozen for a long time. Tim thought about it and decided to help her. He tagged her, and she was free to play again. The other players saw this and started to help each other too. In the end, everyone was happy and had fun. The moral of the story is to be kind and help others.

Tommy was very frustrated. His favorite toy was stuck in the jug, and he couldn't get it out. He tried and tried, but it wouldn't come out. He cried and told his mommy, who came to the rescue. She took a deep breath, grabbed something sharp, and started to cut the jug open. Suddenly, the toy came flying out at high speed, and Tommy was so excited! He smiled and thanked his mommy for helping him, and all was well.

Once upon a time, there was a witch named Sally. She was very famous because she could do magic. One day, Sally decided to prepare a special potion. She needed some special ingredients like frog legs and spider webs. She went to the forest to collect them. While Sally was collecting the ingredients, she met a little girl named Lily. Lily was lost in the forest and was scared. Sally helped her find her way back home. Lily was very happy and thanked Sally. She told everyone about the kind witch who helped her. Sally felt good that she could help someone. She finished preparing her potion and it turned out to be the best one she had ever made. From that day on, Sally became even more famous for her kind heart and her magical potions.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She had a photo of herself and she wanted to improve it. She wanted it to look more beautiful. But when she saw the photo, it looked harsh. So she asked her mom for help. Mom smiled and told her what to do. She said she should use bright colors. So the little girl went to get some paints. Next, she painted on the photo. She was very careful to make sure her colors were bright and cheerful. Soon, the photo was filled with beautiful colors. At last, the little girl was happy with the photo. It was much more beautiful now. She had improved it.

Once upon a time, there was a little bug. The bug had six legs and liked to crawl around on the ground. One day, the bug saw a bright jug. The jug was shiny and looked like it was filled with yummy juice. The bug wanted to drink the juice, so it crawled inside the jug. But the jug was too slippery and the bug couldn't crawl back out. The bug tried and tried, but it was stuck inside the jug. As the sun went down, the bug realized it was getting dark and cold. It started to feel scared and lonely. The bug wished it had never crawled inside the jug. Sadly, the bug could not escape and was stuck inside the jug forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy found a spear on the ground. He thought it was cool and wanted to play with it. But his mom told him that it could hurt him and he should leave it alone. Timmy listened to his mom and left the spear on the ground. Later that day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy saw the spear and wanted to play with it. Timmy remembered what his mom said and told Billy that it could hurt him. Billy didn't listen and picked up the spear. He accidentally hurt himself and started crying. Timmy's mom came outside and saw what happened. She told Billy that he should have listened to Timmy and not picked up the spear. Timmy learned that it's important to listen to his mom and not play with dangerous things. He loved his friends and didn't want them to get hurt.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Alice. She loved to go on adventures! Her favorite thing was to get her passport and check out different places around the world. One day, Alice asked her mom if she could get her passport and go on an adventure. But her mom was feeling a bit grumpy and said no. Alice was very unhappy and started to cry. "What did I do wrong?" she asked. Alice's mom looked at her with a smile and said, "That's okay my darling. You can still have an adventure, just not with a passport. I can tell you a story about a far away place that would be fun for you to explore!" Alice nodded her head and smiled. Soon, she was off exploring this magical world her mom had told her about. She had an amazing time, and realized that sometimes even without a passport you can still have a great adventure!

Anna and Ben were twins who loved Christmas. They wanted to see Santa Claus and get many gifts. They wrote letters to Santa and put them in a big red sock. They hung the sock on the chimney in the living room. On Christmas Eve, they lay in their beds and tried to sleep. But they were too excited and curious. They wanted to sneak out and peek at the chimney. Maybe they would see Santa or hear his sleigh. "Ben, are you awake?" Anna whispered. "Yes, I am. Do you want to go downstairs?" Ben whispered back. "Yes, let's go. But we have to be very quiet and careful. We don't want to scare Santa away." Anna said. They got out of their beds and put on their slippers. They tiptoed down the stairs and hid behind the couch. They looked at the chimney and saw a big sack full of gifts. They also saw a plate of cookies and a glass of milk. "Wow, look at all those gifts! Santa is so generous!" Ben said. "Shh, I hear something. It sounds like bells and hoofs." Anna said. They saw a flash of red and white and a big black boot. Then they heard a jolly voice. "Ho ho ho! Merry Christmas, Anna and Ben! I'm glad you liked my gifts. And thank you for the cookies and milk. They were delicious. Now, go back to bed and have sweet dreams. I have to go and visit more children. Bye bye!" Santa said. Anna and Ben were amazed and happy. They saw Santa! He was real and kind. They ran back to their beds and hugged their teddy bears. They fell asleep with smiles on their faces. They had the best Christmas ever.

Once upon a time, there was a penguin named Pete. Pete loved to travel to new places. One day, he decided to go to the North Pole. It was very icy there, but Pete had a warm coat. As he was walking, he found a handle on the ground. It was a shiny handle that sparkled in the sun. Pete picked it up and carried it with him on his journey. After a while, Pete met some other penguins who were lost. They didn't know how to get back home. Pete used the handle to dig a path through the snow and they all followed him. They were very happy to have found their way home. From that day on, Pete always carried the handle with him on his travels. It helped him and others when they needed it. Pete was a happy penguin who loved to explore new places and help his friends.

Bob loved to jump. He jumped up and down, around and around. Everywhere Bob went, he jumped. One day, Bob went to the lab. It was a very big and strange place. The walls were all white and there was nobody else around, except for Bob. It was very lonely. Bob started to jump around the lab. He jumped on the chairs and the desks. He jumped so high, he could touch the ceiling! Suddenly, from nowhere, a voice said, "Stop jumping!" Bob looked around, but he couldn't see where the voice was coming from. Then, Bob looked up and saw a small mouse! The mouse said again, "Stop jumping! You'll scare me!" Bob was so happy, he wasn't alone in the lab anymore! He said to the mouse, "I'm sorry, I won't jump anymore. Would you like to come and jump with me?" The mouse smiled, and then they both started to jump together. They jumped around the lab and it was the most fun that Bob had ever had!

One day, Mummy was helping the little boy organize his toy basket. She said "Let's make the basket nice and tidy, so the toys are all available and easy to find." The boy said, "Alright, Mummy!" He and Mummy sorted through the toys and carefully put them away. The boy enjoyed being organized and helping Mummy. That night, when it was time for bed, Mummy said, "Why don't you pick a toy to play with in bed?" The boy was excited. "Where should I look first?" he asked. Mummy pointed to the basket. "Remember when we organized it today? All the toys should be available and easy to find now." The little boy smiled and went over to the basket. Once he found his favorite toy, he was ready for bed. Mummy smiled back. She was proud that her little boy had helped organize the toy basket, and even more proud that he had remembered what to do when it was time to find his favorite toy.

Once upon a time, two friendly friends were walking through a field. One said to the other, 'Look at the sun, it is so bright today!' The second friend smiled, 'Why don't we take a picnic lunch here in the field?'. His friend eagerly said, 'Yes!'. They quickly loaded the picnic basket with sandwiches, apples and juice. They spread a blanket and sat down in the middle of the field. They talked and laughed as they shared their lunch. Suddenly, a beautiful butterfly flew across the field. They both watched it flutter away in the wind. One of them said, 'That was so friendly'. The other agreed, 'Yes it was, let's take another walk and see what else we can find.' So they set off, through the tall grass and colourful flowers. In the distance, they could see a friendly animal in the field. The friends ran closer, and saw that it was a gentle horse. It neighed and came towards them. The horse was so friendly that they decided to take a ride. They loaded the horse's back with blankets and then hopped on together. They enjoyed the ride around the field, feeling the sun on their faces and the wind in their hair. At the end of the day, the friends waved goodbye to the friendly horse as they walked back home. They had had a wonderful day, filled with adventure and laughter.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they went with their mom and dad to a big park. There was a lake in the park, and Tom and Lily wanted to see it. "Look, Lily, look!" Tom said, pointing to the water. "The lake is so big and blue! Can we go near it?" "OK, Tom, but be careful," Lily said. "The lake is deep and wet. We don't want to fall in." They ran to the edge of the lake and saw many things. They saw fish and ducks and frogs. They saw boats and rocks and trees. They saw the sun and the sky and the clouds. "Wow, this is so pretty!" Lily said, smiling. "Can we touch the water?" "Sure, Lily, but only a little bit," Tom said. "The water is cold and splashy. We don't want to get wet." They dipped their fingers in the water and felt it. It was cold and splashy, just like Tom said. They laughed and made ripples and bubbles. "Look, Tom, look!" Lily said, pointing to the other side of the lake. "There is a big hill over there! It is so high and green! Can we go there?" "OK, Lily, but be careful," Tom said. "The hill is steep and hard. We don't want to get hurt." They ran to the other side of the lake and saw the hill. It was high and green, just like Lily said. It was also mighty and strong. It made Tom and Lily feel small and brave. "Wow, this is so cool!" Tom said, excited. "Can we climb the hill?" "Sure, Tom, but only a little bit," Lily said. "The hill is rough and rocky. We don't want to fall down." They climbed the hill and felt it. It was rough and rocky, just like Lily said. They had to use their hands and feet and be careful. They reached the top and saw the whole park. "Look, Lily, look!" Tom said, amazed. "We can see everything from here! The lake, the boats, the trees, the sun, the sky, the clouds! We are so high!" "Wow, this is so amazing!" Lily said, happy. "We did it, Tom! We climbed the hill! We are so mighty!" They hugged and cheered and felt proud. They looked at the lake and the hill and felt happy. They had a lot of fun at the park. They loved to play outside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sophie. She liked to have fun and explore the world around her. One day, Sophie decided to explore her mommy's kitchen. As Sophie looked around, she saw an interesting looking machine on the counter. It was so exciting and she wanted to find out what it was. She asked her mommy, "What is this?" Mommy smiled and said, "That's a coffee machine! It makes coffee for adults. Do you want to try it?" Sophie nodded eagerly and gave it a squeeze. But it wasn't very comfortable and it made her feel a bit uncomfortable. Her mommy laughed and said, "Oh Sophie, I think it's best if adults use the coffee machine." Sophie smiled and went back to exploring the kitchen. She was glad her mommy was there to help her and make her feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a wild smelly bear who liked to explore. He would travel for many days, sometimes even weeks, before he returned to his cozy cave in the forest. Every time he returned home, he was always excited to find something new. He often found strange places and things that made him happy. One day, he decided to travel farther than usual, away from his home, to discover something special. As he roamed, the wild smelly bear found a delicious berry bush and decided to stay and eat some of the yummy fruit. After eating all of the berries, the bear was so full that he decided to take a nap in a sunny clearing. When the bear woke up, it was dark outside and he realized it was time to return home. He ran and ran, until he eventually arrived back at his nice, cozy cave. The bear was so happy to be home, he smiled and curled up to take another nap. The end!

Once upon a time, there was a kangaroo named Joey. Joey was a big kangaroo who liked to hop and play all day. One day, Joey got lost in the forest and he was confused. He didn't know which way to go to find his way back home. Joey sat down and started to plan. He thought about the way he came and tried to remember the trees and bushes he saw. After a while, Joey figured out the right way and started to hop towards home. When Joey finally made it back home, all his kangaroo friends were so happy to see him. They asked him where he had been and Joey explained that he got lost but he made a plan to find his way back. From that day on, Joey was known as the smartest kangaroo in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a good knight. He was very brave, and always wanted to help people. One day, he heard a call for help. Someone was in trouble! The knight got on his horse and went to the place where the sound had come from. When he arrived, he saw an evil dragon. The dragon wanted to hurt a little girl. The knight took out his sword and fought the dragon. He beat the dragon and rescued the little girl. She was so happy. The knight was very thoughtful and made sure the little girl was safe. He took her home and everyone was thankful. The knight was a hero, and everyone praised him. He had been so brave and saved the little girl with his sword. Everyone was glad.

Tim and Lily wanted to make a house for their toys. They found some old boxes and some pine cones in the yard. They thought the pine cones would be good for the roof. "Let's measure the boxes and see how big we can make the house," Tim said. He took a stick and marked the length and width of each box on the ground. Lily nodded and helped him. She liked to measure things. She wanted to be a builder when she grew up. They stacked the boxes on top of each other and made a big square. Then they put some pine cones on the top to make a pointy roof. They cut out a door and some windows with scissors. "Look, we made a house!" Lily said. She was very proud of their work.
