One day, she was drawing a beautiful picture of a flower, but she accidentally spilled the ink all over her paper. She was very sad because she thought she ruined her drawing. But then, her mom came in and saw what happened. She told Lily not to be sad and that she could keep the drawing and make it into something new. Lily was excited and asked her mom what she could do with it. Her mom suggested they cut out the flower from the paper and glue it onto a card to give to her grandma. Lily loved the idea and worked hard to make the card. When she gave it to her grandma, she was so happy and proud of what she had made. From then on, Lily learned that even when things don't go as planned, she can always keep trying and make something even better.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play with their toys. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big file that their dad gave them. They used the file to make shapes and sounds on different things, like wood, metal and plastic. They had a lot of fun with the file, but they did not share it with anyone. One day, their mom brought home a new pet, a small kitten. She was white and fluffy and had blue eyes. She was very cute and friendly. Mom said her name was Snowy and she needed a lot of love and care. Lily and Ben were happy to see the kitten, but they did not want to play with her. They wanted to play with their file. Mom asked them to help her feed the kitten. She gave them a bowl of milk and a spoon. She said they had to be gentle and patient with Snowy, because she was still very young and scared. Lily and Ben took the bowl and the spoon, but they did not feed the kitten. They used the spoon to scoop up the milk and pour it on the file. They thought it was funny to see the file get wet and shiny. They laughed and made noises with the file. Snowy was hungry and sad. She meowed and tried to get some milk, but Lily and Ben pushed her away. They did not care about the kitten. They only cared about their file. Mom came back and saw what they were doing. She was very angry and disappointed. She took the file and the bowl away from them. She said they were spoiled and selfish. She said they did not deserve to have the file or the kitten. She said they had to learn to share and be kind. She said she would give the file and the kitten to someone else who would appreciate them. Lily and Ben were shocked and sorry. They realized they had been very mean and rude. They cried and begged Mom to forgive them. They said they wanted to feed the kitten and play with her. They said they would share the file and their other toys with her and their friends. They said they would be good and helpful. Mom saw that they were sincere and sorry. She hugged them and said she loved them. She said she was glad they learned their lesson. She said she would not give away the file and the kitten, but they had to promise to be nice and generous. She said they had to show her that they could be responsible and caring. Lily and Ben nodded and smiled. They said they would do their best. They thanked Mom and said they loved her. They went to feed the kitten and play with her. They used the file to make toys and games for her. They also invited their friends to join them. They had a lot of fun with the file and the kitten. They learned to share and be kind. They were happy and grateful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in nature. She liked to watch the birds fly and the flowers grow. One day, she saw a little bird with a hurt wing. Lily wanted to help the little bird, so she brought it some seeds to eat and some water to drink. The little bird felt better and flew away. Lily felt happy that she could help the little bird. Later that day, Lily's mom made her favorite meal for dinner. Lily said "thank you" to her mom and gave her a big hug. Lily felt grateful for her mom's kindness. After dinner, Lily went outside to watch the sunset. She saw the beautiful colors in the sky and felt grateful for the beauty of nature. She said "thank you" to the world for all the wonderful things it has.

Lily and Ben were playing with their bikes in the park. They liked to ride fast and make turns and jumps. Lily was good at balancing on one wheel. She could lift her front wheel or her back wheel and keep going. Ben wanted to learn how to do that too. "Can you teach me how to balance on one wheel?" Ben asked Lily. "Sure, I can teach you. It is fun and easy. You just have to pedal hard and lean a little bit," Lily said. She was generous and liked to help her friend. Lily showed Ben how to balance on one wheel. She lifted her front wheel and rode for a few seconds. Then she lifted her back wheel and rode for a few more seconds. She smiled and waved at Ben. "Wow, you are so good at balancing on one wheel. Let me try," Ben said. He tried to copy Lily, but he was not very good. He lifted his front wheel, but he lost his balance and fell down. He scraped his knee and started to cry. "Ouch, that hurts. I can't balance on one wheel. It is too hard," Ben said. Lily got off her bike and ran to Ben. She hugged him and said, "Don't cry, Ben. It is okay. You just need to practice more. You can do it. I will help you. Here, take my band-aid and put it on your knee. It will make you feel better." Lily gave Ben her band-aid. She was generous and kind. Ben smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are a good friend. Can we try again?" "Of course, we can try again. Come on, let's get back on our bikes and have some fun," Lily said. Lily and Ben got back on their bikes and tried to balance on one wheel. They had some falls and some laughs, but they did not give up. They had fun and learned something new. They were happy and proud.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their toy guns. They have cheap toy guns that make noise and light. They find some empty bottles in the trash. They put the bottles on the wall. They want to shoot the bottles. "Ready, aim, fire!" Tom says. He shoots his toy gun at a bottle. The bottle falls down and breaks. "Yeah! I got one!" Tom says. "My turn!" Sam says. He shoots his toy gun at another bottle. The bottle does not fall down. It is too far. "Oh, no! I missed!" Sam says. "Try again!" Tom says. He gives Sam his toy gun. "This one is better. It shoots farther." "Thanks!" Sam says. He takes Tom's toy gun. He shoots it at the same bottle. The bottle falls down and breaks. "Yeah! I got it!" Sam says. "Good job!" Tom says. He claps his hands. "You are a good shooter!" They hug each other. They are happy. They shoot more bottles until they have no more. They have fun with their cheap toy guns and bottles.

One sunny day, a little girl named Lucy was playing in the park. She was having so much fun running and skipping and singing. Then, Lucy noticed a marching band heading towards her. She was so excited! The marching band had drums and horns and all sorts of noisy instruments. Lucy loved watching them march around and around. After a few minutes, the band marched away, and Lucy decided to start playing her own pretend marching band. She started marching around with her teddy bear Paul in one hand and her jump rope in the other. As she marched, Paul and Lucy started to sing a fun marching song. Suddenly, Lucy's mom came to the park. She realized Lucy was trying to copy the marching band and said, "Lucy, that was very noisy! We don't need any more marching here. It's time for a different sport. Let's go play catch!" Lucy groaned, but she knew her mom was right. Lucy needs to stop being so noisy and play a different sport. So, they put away their marching and went to play catch instead.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tim. He was three years old and he liked to explore the world around him. One day he was on a walk and he saw a cabin. He thought it looked so strange and it made him hurry to take a closer look. When he got to the cabin, he was so surprised. It was terrible! It was full of cobwebs and the windows were broken. Tim was scared, but he was also curious to see what was inside. He decided to stay and take a look. When he opened the door, he saw a big scary man. Tim was so scared that he ran away and he ran as fast as he could. He was so scared and he couldn't help but hurry home. When Tim got home, he told his mom all about it. She was so glad that Tim was safe and that was the end of his terrible adventure!

Once upon a time there were two kids called Bob and Sam. They liked to act all day long. One day it started to flood. Bob and Sam were scared and didn't know what to do. Just then, their dad came to help. He said that everything would be alright. Then he showed them what to do. He said it was very important to stay calm and act good. So they did as they were told. Bob and Sam stayed calm and acted good. The flood stopped and they were safe. They were so happy and thanked their dad for helping them. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a wild dog named Spot. Spot liked to run and play all day. One day, he met a new friend named Kitty. Kitty was a small, cute cat. They wanted to play together. Spot said, "Let's play near the big tree!" But Kitty was scared. She said, "I heard there might be an earthquake soon. Let's play somewhere safe." Spot didn't listen and ran to the big tree. Suddenly, the ground shook! It was an earthquake! Spot was scared and ran back to Kitty. He said, "I'm sorry, I should have listened to you." Kitty said, "It's okay, Spot. We can still play, but let's be safe." They played together and had lots of fun. Spot learned to listen to his friends and not to regret his choices.

Jill and Ben are twins. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a shiny thing in the grass. It is a diamond. Jill and Ben want the diamond. "Give me the diamond!" Jill says. "No, it is mine!" Ben says. They both hold the diamond and struggle. They pull and tug and twist. The diamond is hard and sharp. It hurts their hands. "Ow!" Jill says. "Ow!" Ben says. They let go of the diamond and look at their hands. They have red marks and scratches. They feel sad and sorry. "I am sorry, Jill," Ben says. "I am sorry, Ben," Jill says. They hug and say they are sorry. They do not want the diamond anymore. They see a cute dog in the park. It is brown and fluffy. It wags its tail and licks their faces. Jill and Ben laugh and pet the dog. They forget about the diamond. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was an impatient pilot. He was always anxious to fly his plane. One day, there was a storm and a lot of rain. The ground started getting really wet. The impatient pilot wanted to fly, but the ground was too wet. He was so desperate that he tried to dry the ground with a blow dryer. He used the blow dryer for hours, but the ground just wouldn't dry. The impatient pilot kept on trying, but it didn't help. After a few hours, he was exhausted and had to give up. The ground remained wet and so the pilot could not fly. He was so disappointed that he flew away on foot. The end.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Tom and Lucy. Tom was a curious little boy who wanted to try new things. One day he said to Lucy, "I want to learn about the world. Can you help me?" Lucy replied, "Yes, of course I can! I know a modern way to learn." Tom was very excited. "What is it?" he asked. "It's called a computer," said Lucy. "It can show you many things. You can use it to learn about different places, animals and plants. I think it will be lots of fun." Tom's eyes lit up. "Let's do it!" he said. So the two of them went to the library to use the computer. The modern computer showed them many amazing things, and Tom learned a lot. He was so happy and smiled happily at Lucy. "That was great!" he said. "Yes," said Lucy. "Learning is really fun!"

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. They see a pond with ducks and fish. Lily and Tom want to watch the ducks and fish. They sit on the grass near the pond. They see many ducks and fish. The ducks swim and quack. The fish splash and jump. Lily and Tom are happy. They clap their hands and laugh. Lily sees a pebble on the ground. It is smooth and shiny. Lily picks up the pebble. She wants to show it to Tom. She says, "Look, Tom, I have a pebble. It is pretty." Tom looks at the pebble. He likes it too. He says, "Can I hold it, Lily? I want to feel it." Lily says, "OK, Tom, you can hold it. But be careful. Do not drop it in the pond." Tom takes the pebble from Lily. He feels it in his hand. It is cold and hard. He says, "Wow, Lily, this pebble is nice. Thank you for sharing it with me." But Tom is clumsy. He moves his hand too fast. The pebble slips from his hand. It falls in the pond. Splash! Lily and Tom are sad. They watch the pebble sink in the water. They cannot see it anymore. They say, "Oh no, Tom, you dropped the pebble. Now we lost it." The ducks and fish are curious. They swim to the pebble. They see it on the bottom of the pond. They think it is a new toy. They play with it. They push it and nibble it. Lily and Tom see the ducks and fish playing with the pebble. They are surprised. They say, "Look, Lily, look, Tom, the ducks and fish have the pebble. They like it too." Lily and Tom are not sad anymore. They are happy. They smile and say, "That's OK, Tom, you did not mean to drop the pebble. The ducks and fish can have it. They are our friends too." Lily and Tom watch the ducks and fish play with the pebble. They giggle and hug. They have fun in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She went to a restaurant with her family. When they sat down, the waiter gave them a menu. Lily looked at the menu and saw some unusual foods she had never seen before. She asked her mom what they were, and her mom explained. After they ordered, Lily saw a big TV on the wall. It was displaying pictures of animals. She pointed and said "Look, mom! Animals!" Her mom smiled and they talked about the animals they saw. When their food came, Lily's dish was unusual too. It had bright colors and looked very pretty. She was so happy to try it. After they finished eating, Lily's dad paid the bill and they left the restaurant. Lily said "Bye-bye, animals!" as they walked out.

Wendy was a little girl who liked to imagine. One day she was playing in the garden when suddenly an amazing thing happened. She saw a fairy flying in the sky! Wendy was so excited but the fairy looked very upset. Wendy called out to the fairy, "Hello! What's wrong?" But the fairy didn't answer. She just kept flying away. Wendy decided to follow the fairy to see why she was so upset. She ran and ran, but the fairy flew faster and she got too far away. Finally, Wendy stopped running. She was sad and a bit out of breath so she sat down to rest. As she sat there, she closed her eyes and imagined what could have made the fairy so upset. She imagined that maybe the fairy had lost her way and needed help to find her home. With a renewed sense of hope, Wendy jumped up and started to search for the fairy. She called out to her but the fairy was nowhere to be seen. Suddenly, in the distance, Wendy saw a shimmering light. She knew it was the fairy flying away and that the fairy had now found her way home. Wendy smiled with relief.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy was an ordinary boy who loved to play outside. One day, Timmy's mom told him to clean up his toys or he would break the law. Timmy didn't want to break the law, so he started cleaning up his toys. While he was cleaning, he noticed a big tree in his backyard. He wanted to climb it, but he was scared. His dad saw him looking at the tree and asked him, "Do you want to climb the tree, Timmy?" Timmy replied, "Yes, but I'm scared." His dad said, "You can do it, just lean against the tree and take it slow." So, Timmy leaned against the tree and slowly climbed up. He was so proud of himself and his dad was proud too. They both knew that Timmy had followed the law by cleaning up his toys and had overcome his fear of climbing the tree.

Lily liked to hug her parrot, Coco. Coco was green and red and had a yellow beak. He could talk and say "hello" and "I love you". Lily and Coco were best friends. One day, Lily and Coco went to the park with Mommy. They saw a big dog that was barking and running. Lily was scared of the dog. She held Coco tight and said, "Don't worry, Coco, I will keep you safe." But the dog saw Coco and wanted to play. He ran towards Lily and Coco and jumped on them. Lily screamed and Coco flew away. The dog chased Coco and tried to catch him. Lily cried and Mommy ran to help. Mommy shouted at the dog and made him go away. She hugged Lily and said, "It's okay, Lily, you are safe now. Where is Coco?" Lily looked around and saw Coco on a tree. He was scared and said, "Help, help, I love you." Mommy and Lily called Coco and asked him to come down. Coco was afraid of the dog, but he saw Lily and Mommy and trusted them. He flew down and landed on Lily's shoulder. Lily hugged Coco and said, "I'm sorry, Coco, I'm glad you are safe. I love you." Coco hugged Lily and said, "I love you too." Mommy smiled and said, "Let's go home, Lily and Coco. You are both brave and good." Lily and Coco nodded and went home with Mommy. They were happy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a small rabbit and her name was Sally. Sally was very busy collecting nuts and berries to eat. She put all the nuts and berries in her big bin to take home. One day, Sally decided to try to jump over her bin. She stood in front of her bin and took a deep breath. She took a very big jump and tried to land on the other side of the bin. Just then, Sally heard a voice from behind. "Why don't you try that again?", the voice said. Sally turned around and saw a big frog. "Hello," the frog said. "My name is Froggie and I think you can jump over your bin if you try one more time." Sally got very excited and took another big jump. This time, she made it to the other side of the bin! Froggie clapped and cheered for her. Sally thanked Froggie and waved goodbye as she picked up her bin and hopped away. From that day, Sally knew that when she was busy, if she just tried, she could do great things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to cook. She had a big pot that she used to make soup and stew. One day, her mom said, "Lily, we are having a party tonight and we need to make a special dish. Can you help me?" Lily was excited to help her mom and asked, "What should we make?" Her mom replied, "We need to make a cake, but we don't have any eggs. Can you go to the store and get some?" Lily went to the store, but she couldn't find any eggs. She asked the store clerk if they were available, but they were all sold out. She was sad and thought she wouldn't succeed in making the cake. But then, she remembered that her neighbor had chickens and maybe they had some eggs. She went to her neighbor's house and asked if they had any eggs. They did! Lily was so happy and thanked her neighbor. She went back home and helped her mom make the cake. It was delicious and everyone loved it!
